rawContent: This piece was very difficult to write and edit. It's even more difficult to share. It is a difficult, potentially uncomfortable topic, filled with stories I tried to repress and forget, but needed to be told. I am here to say, sadly, #metoo. https://t.co/1Yeqs8vapw

If you really want to be "for millennials," @buzzfeed, please, take into account the things millennials consume, like your website and all of the stories across the #metoo spectrum, and know that what you report and who you decide to interview matter. They matter a lot.
